content.value: The flow over a rectangular notch depends upon velocity v, the length of the notch $\mathrm { L } ,$ height of water above crest H, acceleration due to gravity g, fluid density $\rho ,$ flow rate over the notch Q and coefficient of discharge $\mathbf { C _ { d } } .$ Determine the dimensionless groups.
